title: Name the house duality built
summary: Duality builds a whole inner house for ego to inhabit. Name duality before it furnishes the mind.
takeaway: Name duality before it furnishes the mind.
lifeApplication: When division starts feeling normal, identify the second allegiance and surrender it before it becomes a home.
